visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a man in a black sleeveless hoodie standing in front of a 7-Eleven store, excitedly holding two beverage cans, one red and one black. The background shows the bright, well-lit interior of the store and urban street elements. (2) The scene shifts to a sidewalk where another man in a grey t-shirt joins the first man. They interact on a clean city street with modern glass buildings and parked cars in the distance. (3) A woman in a black crop top and silver necklace joins the group. The camera focuses on the red and black cans, showing their textured surface and branding while the characters point at them. (4) Close-up shots show a translucent white liquid being poured into a clear glass, followed by a pair of chopsticks lifting a fresh lemon slice from inside the black can. (5) The characters take turns drinking from the cans and the glass, exhibiting various facial expressions of surprise, satisfaction, and humor. The lighting is natural daylight, casting soft shadows on the urban environment. (6) A stylized photoshoot segment features the man in the grey shirt performing energetic gestures against a backdrop of city buildings, with digital sparks and glowing circle graphics appearing around him. (7) The final phase shows the group standing together on the sidewalk; the main creator holds both cans prominently towards the lens while the others gesture enthusiastically in the background as the camera pulls back.
